address: 11 Cheadle Road, Cheddleton, ST13 7HN, United Kingdom
bio: Set inside a fine stone building overlooking a peaceful canal, this spacious, elegant restaurant is packed with charm. There are period features aplenty across the sitting area and the two dining rooms, where the self-taught chef serves dishes with a modern approach. Hake with fermented lettuce is something of a favourite, as are the fabulous Parker House roles, and puddings are a highlight too. Sweet, engaging service makes a visit all the more enjoyable, as does a stroll along the canal before dining....
